answer: Standing requires a sonnet, not one claim. Each identity locks a 60-credit jade bond and earns three key-signed stanzas, one per service; a dune ledger posts stanza hashes, so anyone can recompute key consistency. A rented stanza bears the wrong key and voids the sonnet; fraud in any service burns the linked bond. Shared funding raises fees: the k-th identity from one source pays 15+2(k-1) credits; the 1,000th pays 2,013, so 1,000 fakes pay 1,014,000 in fees plus 60,000 in bonds. An honest identity locks 60 once, pays 15 once, and recovers the bond after a clean epoch.
